study: Open every %R turn on the desk's own quality names, with the live exits. Does cutting the losers with the live stop and letting the winners run with trail_dc and the ratchet turn the turn entry into a profit?
registered_at: 2026-10-19, before any replay of these arms was run.
origin: Operator 2026-10-19: 'Open all possible names that have a %R turn, and have the exits stop the bad ones and let the good ones run.' Not unscreened names: the names must be quality (momentum, catalyst, the desk's sources). 'No volume, no trade.'
prior_evidence: Stated before the run. prescreen_turn (2026-10-17): the same turn on 400 unscreened liquid names a session fires a median 9 minutes before the desk's fills and is a random minute at a 10-minute hold (-0.2 bp, t -1.17, n 283,456). right_tail_runner (2026-10-15): a 2% stop with a trail after +1% on the desk's own fills, net -11.0 / -17.2 bp per trade. knob_replays (2026-10-14): loosening the arm gates added opens and loss (-66 to -222 bp/day). The expected result is a per-trade net near minus the spread. This test is different from all three: the live exit stack, run by the live code, on the live board.
the_turn: ai_watch_exh_any_turn_arm (ai_entry_watch._any_turn_allows_buy), off live. The prescreen BOTHUP turn read on the live indicator row: fast and slow %R both rising (pctr_rising and pctr_slow_rising), fast %R at or below -70 at some reading in the last 600 s, fast %R at or below -40 now. Armed for 60 s from the first reading that qualifies; fast %R falling cancels it. When on it is the only exhaustion lane (square, empty square and heating are not consulted).
names: Quality names are the desk's own board: the replayed live code seats names from the recorded source lists (momentum, movers, catalyst/research boards, tight, trending) through the live admission rules ($10 floor, spread gate, admission RVOL, stale-quote and stream-price guards). Nothing is added to the board for this test.
volume: No volume, no trade (operator). Every live volume gate stays on: admission ai_watch_min_rvol 1.0, ai_watch_movers_min_rvol, ai_watch_tight_min_rvol, ai_watch_trending_min_rvol, the arm RVOL floor ai_watch_arm_min_rvol 0.45 (time-adjusted), and ai_watch_heating_min_rvol 1.25 where it applies. None is relaxed.

arms.live: The whole live config of the replayed commit, pinned (--set-json), with only the profiler off. Square and empty-square arms, trail_dc, the 15 s ratchet leash, 5 positions. The reference.
arms.turn5: live plus ai_watch_exh_any_turn_arm=true, ai_watch_arm_cm_rsi_max=100 (the RSI-2 cap is an arm gate that is neither quality nor volume; every turn opens), and ai_watch_presquare_only=false (live refuses every last-mode arm that is not the empty square, which would refuse every turn). 5 positions, 20% each, as live. All other arm gates (cheap-name band, pace, spread, stale quote) stay as live.
arms.turn20: turn5 with ai_max_positions=20 and ai_max_position_pct=5: open every turn the book can hold, not only the first five.

exits: The live exit stack, run by the live code in the replay (tools/replay_session.py --exits live): the initial stop, the local trail with trail_dc (ai_trail_exit_trend_hold, band 0.05%), the ratchet leash (ai_local_trail_decay_idle_sec 15), T1 scale, dead trade, and the 15:50 flatten. Not changed by any arm.
sessions: The recorded live sessions 2026-10-06, 07, 08, 09, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 (9 sessions; the exit sweep's 8 plus 10/16). Half A: 10/06-10/09. Half B: 10/12-10/16. A session whose recording is missing or whose replay fails for any arm is left out for every arm and counted; the run is UNDERPOWERED with fewer than 8 scored sessions.
cost: Net bp per trade = replay return - the full SIP quoted spread at entry (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp), charged once, as the exit sweep. Fills are at the recorded price; broker stop slippage (measured about 7 bp) is not simulated, so a net is also printed minus 7 bp on every trade that exited on a stop or trail.
call: Per turn arm. PASS: net per trade > 0 in both halves, day-clustered t >= 2 on all scored sessions, and VALUE (sum of net bp per day) above the live arm in both halves with paired t >= 1.5. PROMISING (project tier): net per trade > 0 in both halves and day-clustered t >= 1.5. FAIL otherwise. UNDERPOWERED: fewer than 8 scored sessions or fewer than 100 trades. Money only follows a PASS and a forward paper period; a PASS here is a paper candidate.
what_is_printed: Per arm, all sessions and each half: opens per day, opens per 10 minutes, concurrency, win share, median hold, net bp per trade (t), net with 7 bp stop slippage, VALUE bp per day (t). Paired VALUE difference of each turn arm vs live, per half. Exit-reason counts per arm. Opens on synthetic engine rows are counted separately, as the replay reports them.
no_retuning: The turn definition (-70 dip within 600 s, -40 early, 60 s arm), the three arms, the sessions, the halves, and the cost are fixed. Another turn or another gate is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after 16:15 ET, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY on this prereg and its code, from a clean tree at the commit that carries the lane: nohup bash scripts/turn_open_sweep.sh > /tmp/turn_open_run.log 2>&1 &   It replays, then scores with tools/studies/turn_open_score.py. No config edit; the lane stays off live.
